# pdf-lib 1.17.1

`pdf-lib-1.17.1.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution from the pinned
`pdf-lib` package version 1.17.1. `LICENSE.md` preserves its MIT license.
Source: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/tree/v1.17.1
The artifact edition records the exact bundled distribution's SHA-256.

Used only to load and inspect local PDF objects. The intake does not save,
rewrite, render or execute document JavaScript. No specialized signature
validation is supplied by pdf-lib; the local inspection code reads dictionary
and certificate data and explicitly reports validation as not performed.
